summary:
**Space Mission – Interactive Solar System Exploration**

Space Mission is an interactive web-based space exploration project that allows users to experience a simulated rocket journey from Earth to different destinations in our solar system, including the Moon, Mars, and Jupiter.

Users can select a destination, launch a rocket, follow its journey through space, and experience a destination-side camera view upon arrival. The project aims to make space exploration more engaging and accessible through an interactive experience.

By combining rocket movement, destination selection, and changing camera perspectives, Space Mission encourages curiosity about astronomy and planetary exploration. It addresses the challenge of making space science more understandable and interesting, especially for people who may not have access to advanced space simulation tools.

Our goal is to inspire users to explore beyond Earth, learn about our solar system, and develop a greater interest in space science and future exploration.
details:
Space Mission – Interactive Solar System Exploration

Project Overview

Space Mission is an interactive space exploration experience that allows users to simulate a rocket journey from Earth to different destinations in our solar system, including the Moon, Mars, and Jupiter.

Users can select their destination, launch a rocket from Earth, and follow its journey through space. The experience uses changing camera perspectives, beginning with a third-person rocket view and gradually transitioning toward a closer first-person perspective. Upon reaching the destination, users can experience a camera view from the selected planetary environment.

How It Works

The project starts with a realistic Earth-based rocket launch. After selecting a destination, the rocket begins its journey through space. The camera follows the spacecraft during flight, providing a sense of movement and distance. Once the mission reaches its destination, the experience transitions to a pre-installed destination camera view.

Benefits and Intended Impact

  • Makes space exploration more interactive and engaging.
  • Helps users develop an interest in astronomy and planetary exploration.
  • Provides an accessible introduction to space missions and the solar system.
  • Encourages curiosity about different celestial destinations.
  • Creates an enjoyable educational experience through simulation.

Tools and Technologies

The project was developed as a web-based interactive experience using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and web development tools. Vite was used as the development server and build tool, while Netlify was used to deploy and host the project online.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of Space Mission is its focus on experiencing a complete space journey rather than simply viewing planets. The combination of rocket launching, destination selection, camera transitions, and destination-side views creates an immersive exploration experience.

Factors Considered During Development

We considered visual realism, camera movement, destination selection, the feeling of distance during space travel, user experience, and accessibility through a web browser. Our goal was to make space exploration enjoyable and understandable for a wider audience.
